transport.description: HTTP GET issued through the coding-agent hosted fetch egress, which reaches a810-bisweb.nyc.gov. The response body is returned as extracted page text, not raw HTML; the extraction is stored verbatim as the artifact.
transport.rawHtmlUnavailableReason: The agent fetch transport returns extracted text only, and every direct client on the acceptance workstation network is refused by the BIS edge (see localNetworkAccess).

localNetworkAccess.summary: a810-bisweb.nyc.gov refuses every direct request from the acceptance workstation network with HTTP 403 from AkamaiGHost, including the plain bsqpm01.jsp entry page, so raw HTML and browser screenshots of the Property Profile could not be captured locally.
